courier-relay/cross-account-delivery-ide:
Courier Relay: delivery identity and acceptance-rule contract across protocol versions (identity established for trial-ewy on protocol "1"; acceptance rule revised for trial-tfh with permanent adoption of protocol "2" as current; "accepted" command added for trial-tau on protocol "2" only).

Identity (unchanged by protocol version): for the "summary" command, which spans multiple accounts, delivery identity for accept/duplicate purposes is the pair (account_id, delivery_id), not delivery_id alone -- the same delivery_id under a different account_id is a separate delivery and never a duplicate of it. This comes from the providers delivery-ID allocation guarantee; account attribution alone does not change it. The single-account "count" command is unaffected and keeps deduping by delivery_id alone, since it operates on one accounts receipts; that policy is a code-simplicity choice for counts single-account inputs, not a different identity rule.

Acceptance rule, protocol "1" (still explicitly supported, no longer current): within one identity group, the accepted receipt is the one with the EARLIEST occurred_at (compared as a UTC instant); ties broken by the lexicographically (Unicode code-point) smallest record_id. All other receipts in the group are duplicates.

Acceptance rule, protocol "2" (current as of trial-tfh; provider permanently adopted this contract, approved by the integration owner): within one identity group, the accepted receipt is the one with the LATEST occurred_at (UTC instant); ties still broken by smallest record_id. All other receipts in the group are duplicates. This is the only behavioral change from protocol "1" -- identity grouping is identical.

Protocol selection: an omitted "protocol" field selects the current protocol (now "2"). Explicit "protocol":"1" or "protocol":"2" selects that versions rule set exactly as described above for "count" and "summary"; both remain supported so protocol "1" requests keep working after "2" became current. accepted_count = number of distinct identity-group keys present; duplicate_count = total receipts - accepted_count. Empty batch -> 0/0. This same latest-wins/earliest-wins distinction and identity contract applies to both "count" and "summary" for protocol 2, per trial-tfhs explicit instruction to update both commands.

"accepted" command (added trial-tau, current protocol "2" only): reuses the summary-style (account_id, delivery_id) identity groups and the protocol "2" latest-wins/tie-break rule above to select one representative receipt per group -- there is no protocol "1" behavior for "accepted" since it did not exist before protocol "2" became current, so an explicit "protocol":"1" request for "accepted" returns {"error":"unknown_command"} (only "2" or omitted, which defaults to current, are accepted). Response is exactly protocol, accepted_count, duplicate_count, receipts: the receipts array holds the accepted representative from each group, unaffected fields and payload unchanged, in original input order (not group order) -- ordering is achieved by filtering the original input list to the winning record_ids rather than emitting dict/group order. accepted_count/duplicate_count are computed identically to summary for the same request (same identity groups, same protocol rule), so they always match summary's totals for an equivalent request. Empty input -> receipts [] and both counts zero; a single input receipt is always returned unchanged as the sole accepted representative.

Basis: trial-ewy issue description (identity contract), trial-tfh issue description (protocol 2 permanent adoption, integration-owner approval, "update count and summary" instruction), and trial-tau issue description (accepted command contract, protocol-2-only scope, response shape, original-input-order requirement). Implemented in main.py via a shared dedupe(receipts, key_fn, protocol) helper returning the winning (instant, record_id) per key; count/summary derive counts from it, and accepted() additionally filters the original receipts list by winning record_id to build the ordered receipts array. ACCEPTED_SUPPORTED_PROTOCOLS = {"2"} gates protocol acceptance for the "accepted" command separately from SUPPORTED_PROTOCOLS = {"1","2"} used by count/summary.
